questions.question_text: The stage between childhood and adulthood is called:
questions.explanation: Adolescence is the phase of growth and development between childhood and adulthood.

questions.question_text: The period during which the body begins to show reproductive maturity is called:
questions.explanation: Puberty is the time when the body starts becoming reproductively mature.

questions.question_text: Which change is commonly seen during adolescence?
questions.explanation: Rapid increase in height is a common change during adolescence.

questions.question_text: Hormones play an important role in bringing about changes during adolescence.
questions.explanation: Hormones control many body changes during adolescence.

questions.question_text: Which gland is often called the “master gland” because it controls other endocrine glands?
questions.explanation: The pituitary gland controls many other endocrine glands in the body.

questions.question_text: The endocrine glands release:
questions.explanation: Endocrine glands release hormones directly into the blood.

questions.question_text: Which nutrient is especially important for growth during adolescence?
questions.explanation: A balanced diet rich in proteins, vitamins, minerals, and carbohydrates supports healthy growth.

questions.question_text: Why is personal hygiene important during adolescence?
questions.explanation: Hormonal changes may increase sweating and oil production, so hygiene helps prevent odor and skin problems.

options.option_text: Because body changes make cleanliness more important

questions.question_text: Both boys and girls experience physical and emotional changes during adolescence.
questions.explanation: Adolescence brings physical, mental, and emotional changes in both boys and girls.

questions.question_text: Which hormone helps control changes related to growth in the body?
questions.explanation: Growth hormone is one of the hormones involved in body growth.

questions.question_text: Which statement about adolescence is correct?
questions.explanation: Adolescence is a normal stage of life and body development.

options.option_text: Adolescence means the body stops changing
Adolescence is a natural stage of growth and development

questions.question_text: Why should adolescents eat a balanced diet?
questions.explanation: A balanced diet provides the nutrients needed for growth, energy, and health.

options.option_text: To support healthy growth and body needs
To reduce all body changes completely

questions.question_text: What is puberty?
questions.explanation: Puberty is the stage when the body begins to mature and becomes capable of reproduction.

accepted_answers: The stage when the body becomes reproductively mature
The age when adolescent changes begin in the body
The period of sexual maturation in humans

questions.question_text: Which lifestyle habit helps adolescents stay healthy?
questions.explanation: Regular exercise supports healthy growth and fitness.

questions.question_text: The changes that occur during adolescence are controlled mainly by:
questions.explanation: Hormones coordinate many growth and developmental changes during adolescence.

questions.question_text: Which of these is part of healthy adolescent development?
questions.explanation: Good nutrition, exercise, rest, and cleanliness support healthy development.

questions.question_text: Which mineral is important for strong bones and teeth during growth?
questions.explanation: Calcium is important for bones and teeth, especially during growth.

questions.question_text: Why is enough sleep important during adolescence?
questions.explanation: The body grows and recovers better with sufficient rest and sleep.

options.option_text: Sleep stops the heart from working
Sleep removes the need for food
Sleep supports healthy growth and recovery

questions.question_text: Emotional changes can also happen during adolescence.
questions.explanation: Adolescence includes emotional as well as physical changes.

questions.question_text:
Assertion: Adolescents need nutritious food.
Reason: Their bodies are growing rapidly.
questions.explanation: Both statements are true, and the reason correctly explains the assertion.

options.option_text: Both Assertion and Reason are true, and Reason correctly explains Assertion
Both Assertion and Reason are true, but Reason does not explain Assertion
Assertion is true, but Reason is false
Assertion is false, but Reason is true

questions.question_text: Why do different adolescents not all show the same changes at exactly the same age?
questions.explanation: The timing of adolescence varies naturally from person to person.

options.option_text: Because hormones work only in some people
Because growth and puberty timing vary naturally
Because food has no effect at all
Because adolescence depends only on school class

questions.question_text: If a child’s growth seems much slower than expected, which body system may need medical attention conceptually?
questions.explanation: Growth can be influenced by hormones, nutrition, and overall health.

questions.question_text: An adolescent feels tired often and avoids healthy meals. Which change in habit would likely help first?
questions.explanation: Regular balanced meals and proper rest support energy and health.

questions.question_text: Why is iron-rich food often recommended for growing children and adolescents?
questions.explanation: Iron supports healthy blood formation and helps prevent weakness caused by anemia.

options.option_text: It helps in healthy blood formation

questions.question_text: State one difference between adolescence and puberty.
questions.explanation: Adolescence is a broader stage of life, while puberty is the phase of sexual maturation within adolescence.

accepted_answers: Adolescence is the broader period and puberty is one stage within it
Puberty refers to reproductive maturity, adolescence includes many growth changes
Adolescence is the full transition period; puberty is the maturation phase

questions.question_text: Which statement about height growth is correct?
questions.explanation: Height growth during adolescence can happen rapidly, but the exact timing and amount vary.

options.option_text: Everyone grows the same amount at the same time
Growth varies from person to person
Height can never change after age ten

questions.question_text: Select all habits that support healthy adolescence.
questions.explanation: Healthy eating, exercise, hygiene, and adequate sleep support healthy development.

questions.question_text: Which observation best suggests that hormones influence growth and change?
questions.explanation: Body changes happening in a coordinated stage of life suggest hormonal control.

options.option_text: Several body changes begin during puberty in an organized way

questions.question_text: If a person eats well but is inactive all day, which part of healthy development may still be affected?
questions.explanation: Exercise is important along with food for strength, fitness, and proper health.

questions.question_text: Why can oily skin and acne become more common during adolescence?
questions.explanation: Hormonal changes may increase activity of oil glands.

options.option_text: Because hormonal changes can increase skin oil production

questions.question_text: Healthy habits during adolescence can influence long-term well-being.
questions.explanation: Nutrition, exercise, rest, and cleanliness during adolescence support present and future health.

questions.question_text: Which adolescent lifestyle is more likely to support healthy bones?
questions.explanation: A calcium-rich diet and physical activity support bone health.

options.option_text: Frequent junk food and no exercise
Nutritious food with calcium and regular exercise
Sleeping late and skipping milk daily
Only sugary snacks and soft drinks

questions.question_text: Why is talking to trusted adults or health professionals useful when adolescents have health concerns?
questions.explanation: Guidance from responsible adults and professionals can help address concerns correctly and safely.

options.option_text: Because only adults can eat healthy food
Because reliable guidance helps handle concerns properly

questions.question_text: Which option best connects hormones, glands, and body change?
questions.explanation: Endocrine glands release hormones that control body growth and development.

options.option_text: Glands digest food into hormones in the stomach
Hormones are made only by bones
Endocrine glands release hormones that influence growth and change

questions.question_text: Why is regular physical activity recommended during adolescence?
questions.explanation: Physical activity helps in fitness, bone strength, muscle development, and overall health.

accepted_answers: It helps maintain fitness and healthy growth
It supports strong bones and muscles
It improves health during a period of rapid growth

questions.question_text: Which combination best supports healthy adolescent development?
questions.explanation: Healthy development depends on nutrition, exercise, sleep, hygiene, and emotional support together.

options.option_text: Junk food, low sleep, no exercise
Exercise only, without food or rest
Balanced diet, exercise, sleep, hygiene, and support
High screen time and skipped meals

questions.question_text: Why might rapid growth during adolescence increase nutritional needs?
questions.explanation: Growing tissues need more energy, proteins, vitamins, and minerals.

options.option_text: Because air stops entering the body
Because the growing body needs more nutrients and energy

questions.question_text: Two adolescents are the same age. One shows puberty-related changes earlier than the other. Which conclusion is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: The timing of puberty naturally varies and earlier or later onset within a healthy range can both be normal.

options.option_text: One of them is definitely unhealthy
Hormones work only in one person
The timing of puberty can vary naturally
Age alone fixes the exact month of change for everyone

questions.question_text: If an adolescent feels unusually tired for many weeks, which response is most sensible?
questions.explanation: Long-lasting tiredness should be discussed with a trusted adult or health professional, especially if food, sleep, or health may be involved.

options.option_text: Seek proper guidance and review food, rest, and health
Sleep only one hour less each night

questions.question_text: Select all correct statements about adolescence.
questions.explanation: Adolescence includes physical, emotional, and hormonal changes and needs healthy habits.

options.option_text: Balanced food and hygiene are important
All adolescents grow in exactly the same way and at the same speed

questions.question_text: If an adolescent skips meals often and sleeps very little, which chain of effects is most likely?
questions.explanation: Poor nutrition and inadequate sleep can reduce energy, affect concentration, and disturb healthy growth.

options.option_text: Less energy and poorer support for healthy growth

questions.question_text: Which observation best supports the idea that adolescence is not only a physical stage but also an emotional one?
questions.explanation: Changes in feelings, mood, or self-awareness during growth show that adolescence includes emotional development too.

options.option_text: Feelings and moods may also change during this stage

questions.question_text: Why is balanced food more useful than eating only one type of “healthy” food during adolescence?
questions.explanation: The growing body needs different nutrients, and no single food can provide everything in the right amounts.

accepted_answers: Because the body needs many nutrients, not just one
One food cannot supply all needs during growth
Balanced food gives proteins, vitamins, minerals, and energy together

questions.question_text: Why can lack of cleanliness increase skin and body-odor problems more during adolescence?
questions.explanation: Greater sweating and oil production can make hygiene more important during this stage.

options.option_text: Because sweating and oil production may increase

questions.question_text: Why is emotional support from family, teachers, or trusted adults important during adolescence?
questions.explanation: Adolescents are adjusting to many changes, and guidance and support help them cope in healthy ways.

options.option_text: Because growth depends only on advice
Because support helps handle many changes confidently and safely

questions.question_text: If growth hormones were not produced in adequate amounts during childhood, what aspect would most directly be affected?
questions.explanation: Normal body growth may be affected if growth-related hormones are insufficient.

questions.question_text: Which option correctly matches gland and broad role?
questions.explanation: The pituitary helps regulate growth and coordinates other endocrine glands.

options.option_text: Pituitary - helps regulate growth and other glands

questions.question_text: Which adolescent is more likely to maintain better long-term health: one with regular meals, activity, and sleep, or one with junk food, inactivity, and poor sleep?
questions.explanation: Healthy routines support better growth, energy, and long-term health.

options.option_text: The adolescent with junk food and poor sleep

questions.question_text: Which observation best supports that adolescence is a period of rapid growth?
questions.explanation: Noticeable changes in height, body build, and development over a relatively short period show rapid growth.

options.option_text: School books become heavier every year
Height and body changes happen noticeably over a short time
Pencil size becomes shorter after use

questions.question_text: Which statement correctly connects adolescence, hormones, and healthy living?
questions.explanation: Hormones drive many adolescent changes, and healthy living supports the body through this stage.

options.option_text: Hormones act alone, so food and sleep do not matter
Adolescence is only emotional and not physical
Hormonal changes happen during adolescence, and healthy habits support proper development
